_comment: DAY-STATE gate, both branches. Forces UseDayATRGate=1 and sweeps the two thresholds (12 evaluations): entry is allowed while the day's range is still under FreshDayATR*dailyATR (the day barely started) OR already over SpentDayATR*dailyATR (the day is spent), never in between. Raising FreshDayATR widens the early-entry window, lowering SpentDayATR widens the late-entry one, and the gap between them is the dead band. Beware: these are two DIFFERENT strategies sharing one code path (early trend entry vs mean-reversion after a sell-off), and a single profit factor averages them together — to separate them, run this file twice with one branch collapsed (FreshDayATR near zero, or SpentDayATR far above any reachable range). The UseDayATRGate=0 control point lives in cal_screen.json. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker GAZP -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/cal_day.json -out ./reports/GAZP_day -months 24 -min-trades 20 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor
